key.name: albums-enabled
key.description: The Albums tab, wherever the library opens.

key.name: artists-enabled
key.description: The Artists tab, wherever the library opens.

key.name: playlists-enabled
key.description: The Playlists tab, wherever the library opens.

key.name: radio-enabled
key.description: The Radio tab, wherever the library opens.

key.name: browser-command
key.summary: Browser command for Apple Music engine
key.description: Command used to launch Chrome for the Apple Music engine.

key.name: engine-port
key.description: Port Chrome's DevTools protocol (CDP) listens on, bound to 127.0.0.1.

key.name: engine-headless
key.description: Run the Apple Music Chrome instance in the background without a window.

key.name: engine-autostart
key.description: Start the engine when the library opens.

key.name: sync-interval
key.description: Minutes between automatic syncs; 0 = off.

key.name: last-sync
key.description: Written by the extension after a sync completes.

key.name: player-bar
key.description: Show the playback control bar at the bottom of the library view.

key.name: play-on-new-workspace
key.description: When on, playing something moves to an empty workspace first.

key.name: library-opens-in
key.description: Where the library — a tab per section over its grid — is drawn. Whichever it is, the button next to Show Apps opens it and closes it again. "desktop" draws it on the wallpaper of the workspace the button is pressed on; "workspaces" draws it on the wallpaper of a workspace of its own and slides to it, giving that workspace up when it is closed. "menu" puts it in the overview, beside the applications. "modal" pops it up in the folder's panel over the desktop, closed with Escape, a click away, or the button again. Only one is ever built. Where a picked item opens is detail-opens-in, which is read independently of this.

key.name: detail-opens-in
key.description: Where the detail pane of a picked item is drawn. "desktop" puts it on the wallpaper of the workspace the pick was made on — in place of the grid, when the library is drawn there too. "workspaces" puts it on a workspace of its own and slides to it. "menu" pops it up the way the shell opens an app folder, zooming out of the tile, over whatever the pick was made on, and it goes when that tile does. "modal" is the same panel hosted over the desktop always, outliving the overview and a change of workspace until Escape or a click away closes it.

key.name: library-shortcut
key.description: Opens the library wherever library-opens-in puts it, as the button next to Show Apps does, and closes it again when it is what is up. Empty is no shortcut.

key.name: gamepad-enabled
key.description: Navigate a library with a game controller, through libmanette. Only acted on while a library is on screen, except Home, which opens it when no window has the keyboard.

key.name: columns
key.description: Covers per row. Fewer means larger covers. The count is capped by what fits the space the grid is drawn in — the overview's grid slot is the smallest — so a narrow space shows fewer.

key.name: rows
key.description: Rows per page. Fewer means larger covers. The count is capped by what fits the space the grid is drawn in — the overview's grid slot is the smallest — so a narrow space shows fewer.

key.name: grid-align
key.description: Where the covers sit when a row is not full: "center" centres a part-full row under the full ones, as the app grid does; "start" lines it up against the leading edge. Full rows are centred on the page either way.

key.name: corner-radius
key.description: How rounded artwork, tiles and the detail pane are, in pixels. 0 is square. The related radii (hero, thumbnails, rows, pane) scale with it.

key.name: detail-size
key.description: How much of the room available the pop-up detail panel fills, as a percentage. Used when items open in a pop-up (detail-opens-in "menu" or "modal").
